text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Now that was some fine training.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"There was a time when I dabbled in 
something called 'training' myself, but—"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't do it like that! It really is 
pure talent, yup!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful! Keep it up, I'm rooting for 
you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tucker Brine praised me once again!
